posts.title: Putting music data to work
posts.description: I had someone ask me the other day why I collect all the music data that I do and I wasn't sure how to answer. Some of it's an interest in my own listening patterns, and another part of it is nostalgia for the last.fm I used heavily during its heyday. I guess I like quantifying those things. posts.title: Caching, bot defense and a CDN
posts.description: I've been wary of and interested in putting a CDN in front of my site. I had tools in place to block bots ( and several countries ), but they were fragmented and it was an ongoing rock fight. I had a Go job that banned IPs after too many 404s , a crawler denylist that mirrored my robots.txt, and an SQL-injection probe filter (regex).
